## Reusable Calendar

 
```{r cal_setup}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(clock)
library(flexdashboard)
library(kableExtra)

target_year <- 2025L
```
## Picturing the future
Add inspirational quote here. 
"Preparation, preparation, preparation!"

```{r build_dates}
#| echo: false
# date_build returns V strange object, can be a vector of one for each month, but only one for each month, ie not multiple dates
# flexdash initiate
# and format
the_whole_year <- c()
this_month <- 6L
this_day <- 29L
single_date <- date_build(target_year, this_month, this_day)
the_whole_year <- append(the_whole_year, single_date)

# add to table(?()) data struc for flexdashbd
# next date

# output table
the_whole_year |> kable()

```

The year, is: `{r} target_year `
 ... ta-dah!!!
